sources.title: Grand Ming: Very Substantial Disposal - Disposal of Properties
sources.summary: Grand Ming conditionally agreed to sell iTech 3.1 at 3 On Kui Street and iTech 3.2 at 8 On Chuen Street to Amazon Data Services Hong Kong Limited. At iTech 3.1, the first two phases had been delivered in December 2025 and generated rent while remaining development and fit-out continued. iTech 3.2 remained under construction without rental income. The initial sale-closing target was 26 February 2027, subject to conditions.
sources.pages_reviewed: All twelve pages; visually checked pages 6 and 11 for status and addresses.
sources.date_semantics: The current-tense construction paragraph reports conditions at the 18 September announcement. Financial tables below it cover earlier year ends; those table headings do not date the construction statement. September 18 is not the exact start of works.

sources.title: Grand Ming: Delay in Despatch of Circular
sources.summary: The shareholder circular concerning the proposed sale of the two Fanling properties was postponed to on or before 26 October 2026. This notice does not establish a completed sale or a new construction observation.
sources.date_semantics: Announcement date for the circular postponement, not physical-status evidence.

sources.capture_note: Captured 23 October 2026 (12,781 bytes, UTF-8 with BOM) from the link on the bureau's ordinance page (tokyo-hunsou-1.html, sha256 4a39a38e...); the matching PDF (tokyo-hyoshiki-r8-04-09.pdf, sha256 bc018a48..., created 9 October 2026) shows the same row as 第7号. www.toshiseibi.metro.tokyo.lg.jp robots.txt (HTTP 200) was read and recorded before the first request. Re-captured on 25 October 2026 as local_data/country-research-2026-10-25-japan62/ariake/tokyo-current-sign-notifications.csv and byte-identical; retained canonical evidence metadata to reuse the existing capture. This projection now additionally reviews row 31 for Ariake TK2.
sources.summary: Tokyo's list of sign notifications under its ordinance on preventing disputes over medium- and high-rise buildings (buildings over 10,000 m2 in the special wards), received by the bureau's coordination section from April to September 2026. Row 第7号: received 8 May 2026, sign put up 7 May 2026, building name （仮称）江東区千石三丁目計画 新築工事, site lots 江東区千石三丁目2-19, 20, 71 and 89, quasi-industrial zone, height 51.40 m, gross floor area 22,640.00 m2, planned start early July 2026 (R8.7月上旬), principal use その他（データセンター）. The list also records other planned data centres in Koto (Shiohama 2-chome Phase II, Ariake TK2), which are separate projects. Row 31 separately records the combined Ariake TK2 data-centre and Ariake Hotel development: notification received 7 September 2026, sign displayed 4 September 2026, lots 有明二丁目1番65、67、69、75及び三丁目1番24, industrial-exclusive zoning, data-centre height 59.98 m and gross floor area 32,972.49 m2, hotel height 59.80 m and gross floor area 19,721.43 m2, and planned construction start 1 March 2027. Only the data-centre component is selected.
sources.date_semantics: The document identifier encodes an upload on 15 October 2026 (the PDF was created on 9 October 2026); the row's own dates are 7-8 May 2026. Identity context (lot numbers, height, floor area, use) only; the planned start is a forecast and the May dates are outside the window, so no status observation is taken from it. For Ariake TK2, the separate row 31 records the notification received 7 September 2026; that date is used for announced status, not development consent or a physical-work observation. The 4 September sign date and forecast 1 March 2027 start stay separate.

sources.attribution: Aran Tokutei Mokuteki Kaisha / Toda Corporation; photograph: 超高層ビル・都市開発研究所
sources.summary: A photographed developer notice names Aran TMK as building client and Toda Corporation as designer for Ariake TK2. It gives the shared development address as Ariake 3-5-1 and shows the data centre north of a separate hotel. The June notice contains earlier floor-area and height figures; the Atlas uses the later September government specifications.
sources.date_semantics: The notice itself prints a display date of 1 June 2026. The hosting page says the photographs were taken on site in June 2026 and was last updated 14 June 2026; no original digital publication date is asserted. Identity and address bridge only; no current status observation is drawn from this older photograph.
sources.capture_note: Original JPEG response captured 25 October 2026 and visually read. This is a reproduction of a primary on-site developer notice, not a notice downloaded from the developer: preserve the hosting/photographer chain. The exact project name and five lot numbers are independently corroborated by the official Tokyo notification. Do not use the surrounding blog prose, map pin, operator attribution or construction captions as status evidence. The site robots.txt allows this image path (captured after the first request).
